fullName: @pecot/interface-spec-src:tests/definitions.test.ts#generated.json checks generated.json の id の接頭辞の欠落・id の重複・surface の欠落は、それぞれ検証エラーにする

steps.name: 定義書を書き換えて検証する

expect(["plugins/pecot-workflow/interface/authored.yaml|PW-ISSUE-CREATE||entry is not in generated.json (remove it)","plugins/pecot-workflow/interface/authored.yaml|PW... <truncated>).toContain("plugins/pecot-workflow/interface/generated.json|XX-ISSUE-CREATE|id|must start with \"PW-\" and use only A-Z, 0-9 and \"-\"")

expect(["plugins/pecot-workflow/interface/authored.yaml|PW-ISSUE-CREATE||entry is not in generated.json (remove it)","plugins/pecot-workflow/interface/authored.yaml|PW... <truncated>).toContain("plugins/pecot-workflow/interface/generated.json|XX-ISSUE-CREATE|id|is defined more than once")

expect(["plugins/pecot-workflow/interface/authored.yaml|PW-ISSUE-CREATE||entry is not in generated.json (remove it)","plugins/pecot-workflow/interface/authored.yaml|PW... <truncated>).toContain("plugins/pecot-workflow/interface/generated.json|XX-ISSUE-CREATE|surfaces|must have mcp or action")
